Overview

Jimma-bound moves often include office files and household together—declare both at survey for accurate cube estimate.

Combined household + office

  • Seal file boxes with tamper-evident tape and room labels.
  • Load office cartons last for first-out at destination.
  • Confirm Jimma compound gate hours before dispatch.

Inter-city legs from Addis Ababa to jimma need route planning, fuel time, and sometimes overnight staging. Your quote should separate city load/unload from highway hours. Confirm truck class for road condition and whether you need same-day unload at destination or next-morning delivery.

Before moving day

  • Confirm management move rules, freight lift booking, and security ID lists for truck plate and crew.
  • Declutter to reduce volume; label rooms and mark FRAGILE on electronics and glass.
  • Photograph meters and wall condition at origin; repeat at destination before furniture covers walls.
  • Check holiday traffic and end-of-month rush when picking dates.

Quote and contract discipline

Moving day

A crew lead coordinates with security and lift windows. Blankets and disassembly are standard for furniture; heavy items load against stable cab walls for Addis streets. Neighbors in the same tower can share mobilization—group move tips.
